definition.quote: hypothetical YES bid/ask at the captured best price; one paired candidate per exchange every 30 seconds
definition.fillProxy: captured scoped trade at least one tick through limit after activation; one unit at limit; no aggressor/queue rank known
definition.markout: legacy event-time diagnostic only: first captured book source point at or after fill plus horizon; not an executable response-time mark
definition.eventTimeDiagnostic: first eligible captured book source point at or after fill plus horizon, within maximumMarkoutDelayMs; buy exits at future bid, sell exits at future ask; retrospective diagnostic only
definition.executableExit: first fresh captured book with source time at or after fill time plus horizon and local receipt time at or after trade report receipt plus exitResponseLatencyMs; maximumMarkoutDelayMs bounds both event-time horizon delay and local response-time delay; development labels must also have been available before the development cutoff
definition.spreadIncluded: entry joins the observed best side; liquidation crosses the later spread using its executable contra quote
definition.stress: subtract one tick from entry and one tick from exit (0.010000 total per unit) from executable net; shown separately

bins.alignedFlow: tercile cutpoints from development quote features only; when both cutpoints tie, split strictly below / equal / strictly above the tied value; no outcome-guided selection

limitations: Trade-through is a counterfactual fill proxy, not proof an order was accepted or filled; queue priority and aggressor side are unknown.
One unit at the captured limit is assumed; deeper fills, capital, inventory, venue matching rules, cancellations, and latency variation are not simulated.

Event-time markouts are retained as retrospective diagnostics; executable marks require both the event-time horizon and local receipt after the trade report plus modeled exit response, with a fresh source timestamp. Exchange source time and local receipt time are intentionally gated in their own clock domains. Trade-report receipt delay has no assumed upper bound; development marks are excluded unless their captured book receipt/availability is before the development cutoff.
Spread is reflected in executable liquidation; zero platform fees are assumed. One-tick-each-way stress is an additional sensitivity, not an observed fee.
Candidates overlap across markets and outcomes are not independent; small samples and shared market shocks preclude a profitability claim.
Conditional bins are descriptive and prespecified; no strategy selection or actual contest execution is authorized by this analysis.
Candidate quote exposure ends at capture disconnect/invalidation boundaries; fill rates use observed active quote time but captured trade coverage is incomplete.
